We utilise a streamlined structure to elevate market-level decision-making, ensuring rapid, high-quality planning and launches. Building on the consumer discovery journey, this domain owns the regional strategy and operational excellence of core shopping, transaction and post-order experiences. The objective is to remove friction, improve basket building and conversion, and strengthen consumer trust and engagement through scalable Product capabilities. **Key Areas Of Ownership Include** * Search: Improve search relevance, usability and conversion across verticals, reflecting different consumer missions and category needs. * Bundling & Basket Building: Drive adoption and optimisation of Add-ons and Post-Checkout Bundling (PCB), unlocking incremental orders and basket growth through more seamless shopping experiences. * Loyalty UX: Identify opportunities to improve merchant level loyalty discovery and engagement within core consumer journeys, extending relevant capabilities across OFD, Grocery and Retail in partnership with Merchant teams. * Shopping & Order Experience: Improve the end-to-end journey across shopping, checkout, fulfillment, post-order and quality experiences, reducing consumer friction and strengthening reliability and trust. * Category-Specific Experiences: Champion differentiated consumer needs across categories such as Pharma and Alcohol, ensuring core Product capabilities support category-specific shopping behaviours and regulatory requirements. new_jobs.jd: **OVERALL JOB PURPOSE** As a Business Process & Solutions Supervisor, you will lead the team that manages business requests across freight forwarding operations, covering requirement analysis, business value estimation, solution assessment, prioritization, and delivery. For key solutions, you will act as project manager, planning development resources and timelines, and ensure successful implementation through training, go-live support, and ongoing support. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **1. Business Request Assessment** * Engage business owners to clarify needs against end-to-end forwarding processes, assess requirements and propose the process or system solution with expected benefits. **2. Project Evaluation & Review** * Prepare business cases and project proposals with cost-benefit and feasibility analysis, and facilitate the business request review to recommend priorities and track status. **3. Solution Design** * Translate needs into specifications and process designs aligned with forwarding operational standards and systems. **4. Project Management** * Lead key solutions to successful delivery by planning resources and timelines, tracking progress, and keeping requesters informed. **5. During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees. The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions. **Adjustment or Accommodations Request** If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence. **Note to candidates** The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

new_jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager
new_jobs.jd: We are looking for potential talent for **Senior Brand Manager** to drive robust customer insights and deliver promotional effectiveness. In this role, you will be responsible for the effective deployment of global strategies. You will also provide execution leadership across all areas of marketing to achieve short-term and long-term brand sales and profit objectives. **A day in the life** * You will develop, adapt, and refine strategic direction for brand, grounded in consumer and customer insights * Lead the development of annual market activation planning focused on 3-year growth drivers, demonstrating strong leadership of brand centric cross-functional teams * Accountable for the delivery of annual brand Profit & Loss (P&L), including sales and profit results, and actively manage budget items * Support and mentor junior marketing associates on the marketing team * Manage brand equity through successful deployment and localization of global toolkits * Drive innovation strategy through flawless execution of global innovation vision board * Manage agency and cross-functional relationships at both local and global levels to deliver breakthrough results, ensuring that the region’s needs are addressed within the global matrix * Drive superior execution of programs and plans to bring the brand strategies to life, including for media, creative development, and digital programs * Collaborate with the sales team to drive strong customer engagement and in-store support * Drive accountability, tracking results on key brand and programs, recommending course correction as necessary based on performance versus Key Performance Indicators **Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role** * 7+ years’ experience in brand marketing and/or commercial management * Experience translating consumer and customer insights into effective communications and sustainable brand share growth * Experience leading large-scale launches and delivering outcomes through cross-functional collaboration in a matrix organization * Strong financial acumen, including budget management, to drive profitable growth

new_jobs.title: Social Media Content Strategist
new_jobs.jd: **Full-time | Taipei, on-site | NT$55,000+** **Languages: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese required** **Start date: Immediate availability preferred** We’re looking for someone who can turn a brand brief into a content strategy, write scripts that actually shoot well, and push work forward without waiting to be told what to do. **ABOUT ONTRACK** OnTrack is a Taipei-based content marketing agency. We work with regional and international brands across gaming, finance, consumer tech and lifestyle, producing short-form video, paid ad creative and brand content that performs. Our production volume is growing, and we need someone who can lead the creative thinking and turn it into work our team can deliver. **THE ROLE** You turn client briefs into campaign ideas, content strategies, and scripts that work on social. You work closely with our Creative Director, our producer, and our Account Managers, and you own the ideas and scripts on the accounts you're assigned. We're looking for someone ambitious who wants to grow with us. As you prove yourself, you take on more accounts and more ownership. This is a role you can grow into a lead position. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Research social trends, platform behaviour, and competitor content across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, and turn them into creative direction * Write scripts for short-form video, paid ads, and UGC, in English and Chinese * Develop campaign concepts and content strategies for assigned accounts: pillars, formats, hooks, and messaging * Brief our producer, videographers, and editors so they can execute without guessing * Work with the Creative Director on creative vision and quality * Contribute to client proposals and pitches * Review the finished work against the idea and the brief **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** * A strong understanding of social media: what performs, why, and how to design for it * Strong scriptwriting for short-form video. You write for the camera, not for a document * Fluent in English and Chinese, with confidence presenting ideas to international and local clients * Experience in social media, content, or marketing, ideally at an agency * Fresh, specific ideas, and the ability to explain why they work * A doer. You take ownership, move fast, and ship a good first version instead of waiting for the perfect plan **GREAT IF YOU HAVE** * Shoot your own phone-based video: framing, lighting, and audio on simple setups * Edit short-form video * Knowledge of paid ads and performance creative * Experience in gaming, Web3, fintech, or consumer tech * Background in UGC or creator-led content **THIS ROLE IS NOT** * A social media manager role focused on scheduling posts and writing captions * A copywriting-only role * A commercial cinematographer role * A producer role. Talent, locations, and logistics sit with our producer and Account Managers **WHAT TO EXPECT** This is a senior individual contributor position. You should be comfortable leading a creative conversation in a client meeting and taking responsibility for your recommendations. The role involves regular scriptwriting, strategy development and production planning. It goes beyond scheduling posts and writing captions, and it does not involve managing a department.

Repository、Context Layer、MCP Tool Integration、Evaluation、Observability、Secure SDLC、Kubernetes Runtime 及 Hybrid Model Serving，建立具擴充性、可靠性、安全性及可維運性的企業級 Agent 平台 * 設計與建置 Agent Runtime 核心能力，包括 Task Planning、State Management、Tool Execution、Checkpoint、Retry／Recovery、Stop Conditions 及 Human Approval 等機制，並規劃 Single／Multi-Agent Orchestration，確保複雜工程任務可受控、可復原並具備人工介入機制 * 將 AI Agent 深度整合至軟體開發生命週期，建立涵蓋 Repository Understanding、Spec／Issue Decomposition、Coding／Refactoring、Test Generation、PR／Code Review、CI/CD Failure Analysis、Vulnerability Remediation 及 Release Validation 的端到端 Workflow，提升研發效率與交付品質 * 建立 MCP Servers、Typed Schemas、API／CLI Adapters 及 Tool Registry，將 EDA／CAD Tools 封裝為 Agent 可安全操作及驗證的工程工具，並建立明確的 Identity、Permission、Sandbox 及 Review Boundaries；整合 Repository 中的程式、規格與歷史資產，使 Agent 能協助進行 Simulation、Waveform、Log 及 Report Analysis 等半導體研發工作 * 建立 Benchmarks、Regression Suites、Deterministic Graders、End-to-end Traces、Metrics、Quality Dashboards 及 SLOs，持續追蹤 Task Success Rate、Tool-call Correctness、Latency、Cost、Failure及人工介入情況；建立 Production Feedback Loop，將實際使用結果與失敗案例持續回饋至 Repository，提升 Agent 的穩定性與任務完成品質 * 將 SAST、SCA、SBOM、Secret Protection、Repository Rulesets 及 Policy Gates 內建於 Agentic Workflows 與 SDLC，建立平台安全及治理機制；同時規劃 Cloud／On-prem Model Routing、Fallback、Capacity Management、Data Boundary 及 Cost Optimization，兼顧模型能力、資料安全、服務可用性與整體運行成本 * 主導 Architecture Review、Security Review、Platform Standards 制定及關鍵技術問題排除，並負責跨團隊技術決策與架構協調；串聯 R&D、Memory Design、CAD／EDA、Verification、Security 及 Infrastructure 等團隊，將 AI Agent Platform 從 PoC 推進至實際 Production Adoption，建立可持續擴展的工程應用模式 Engineering、Platform Engineering、Developer Productivity 或 AI Systems 相關工作經驗，具大型或企業級系統之設計、開發與 Production 維運經驗 * 精通 Python，並熟悉至少一種可應用於 Production 環境的程式語言，具備良好的軟體工程、程式設計及系統開發能力 * 具 LLM／AI Agent、Developer Tools 或 Engineering Platform 之架構設計、建置或營運經驗，能將 AI 能力實際整合至工程與開發流程 * 熟悉 Backend／Distributed Systems、API、Databases、Docker、Kubernetes、CI/CD、Reliability 及 Observability，具備從系統設計至 Production Deployment／Operations 的完整經驗 * 能設計並落實 Agent Runtime、Tool Calling、Repository-Centric Context、Evaluation Framework 及 Secure SDLC，建立具可驗證、可觀測、可治理及可持續演進的 Agent Platform * 具良好的 System Design 與 Architecture new_jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Emergent AI Infrastructure, Google Cloud
new_jobs.jd: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Google welcomes people with disabilities. **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 1 year of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 1 year of experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems. **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 1 year of experience with software development in a large-scale cloud environment (including internships). * Experience testing, maintaining, and launching software products/infrastructure. * Experience utilizing AI productivity tools to streamline individual, business or development workflows. * Ability to grow in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, adapt to rapidly changing priorities. Exceptional problem-solving skills, bias for action and incremental delivery. * Passion for building deep system skills such as low level system software, OS, firmware, low level networking understanding, or hardware, etc. **About The Job** Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. As a Software Engineer, you will have exposure to fully integrated AI infrastructure systems (GPU and/or TPU), from hardware to software design and workload management, to developing large scale training and inference workloads, and optimizing performance. You will use your experience in building large AI clusters using the latest technologies for AI acceleration and cluster interconnects and networking. We're building the AI infrastructure for the future, so if you are interested in building a brand new product in a fast-paced environment, rather than just evolving an existing one, this may be the role you are looking for. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. **Responsibilities** * Contribute to developing software, tools, infrastructure for the hybrid and on-prem AI infrastructure business. * Work with peer engineers within Google teams to deliver well scoped projects, with good quality and documentation. * Support the team in maintaining and enhancing product, engineering, operational, and support excellence to ensure reliable and high-performance operations. * Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the timely delivery of new product features. * Learn about Google's oncall best practices and participate in an oncall support rotation. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .
